verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an AI gateway, but nothing in the evidence documents a way to stop data from being used to train AI models, such as a no-training commitment or a provider training opt-out. The related features don't qualify: payload-logging controls (cf-aig-collect-log-payload) govern storage, and DLP scanning blocks sensitive data from being sent. Both are adjacent controls, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
